name: Tryowbot
author: Eron Techno Solutions Pvt Ltd

sections.description:
🚀 AUTOMATE WOOCOMMERCE WHATSAPP NOTIFICATIONS

Tryowbot helps WooCommerce store owners send instant WhatsApp notifications automatically when order status changes.

From order confirmation to payment updates, shipping, and delivery alerts — customers receive real-time updates directly on WhatsApp.

This improves customer communication, reduces support tickets, and enhances trust in your WooCommerce store.

👉 Turn your WooCommerce store into a fully automated WhatsApp notification system.

🌟 WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH TRYOWBOT

With a flexible automation system, you can:

• Create order-based WhatsApp triggers
• Map dynamic WooCommerce variables
• Use image-based WhatsApp templates
• Add static or dynamic CTA buttons
• Preview templates before saving
• Manage all automation from the WordPress dashboard

⚡ WHY TRYOWBOT?

✔ Instant WooCommerce WhatsApp notifications
✔ Fully automated order status triggers
✔ Easy dynamic variable mapping system
✔ Support for image-based templates
✔ Smart action buttons (Track Order, Support, Invoice)
✔ Live template preview system
✔ Simple and powerful admin dashboard

Features

  • WooCommerce order status triggers for automation
  • Dynamic variable mapping ({{1}}, {{2}}, etc.) for personalized messages
  • Static and dynamic WhatsApp template support
  • Image upload support for rich notifications
  • Button text and URL mapping for CTA actions
  • Live template preview before saving
  • Secure database storage
  • Clean uninstall support with no leftover data

External Services

This plugin connects to the Tryowbot API to send WhatsApp notifications and retrieve broadcast data.

Service Name: Tryowbot API
Service URL: https://tryowbot.com

API Endpoints used:
– https://webapi.tryowbot.com/v1/send
– https://webapi.tryowbot.com/v1/getapiboradcast
– https://prodapi.tryowbot.com/tryowbotapi/customerweb/v1/api/getapibroadcast

What data is sent:
– Customer phone number
– Order details (order ID, products, totals)
– Message template data

When data is sent:
– When WooCommerce order status changes
– When admin manually triggers a message or broadcast
– Only after API integration is enabled by the admin

Why data is sent:
– To deliver automated WhatsApp notifications to customers and admins

Terms of Service:
https://tryowbot.com/terms-conditions/

Privacy Policy:
https://tryowbot.com/privacy-policy/

Privacy

This plugin processes WooCommerce order data and sends it to an external API service for WhatsApp message delivery.

Data may include:
– Customer phone number
– Order details (products, order ID, status)
– Total amount
– Message content configured by admin

This data is sent only when:
– An order trigger is executed
– Admin manually triggers a message

No personal data is stored externally except what is required for message delivery.

Support

tryowbot@gmail.com

sections.installation:
There are 3 easy ways to install Tryowbot:

📌 1. Install from WordPress Plugin Directory

  1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Tryowbot”
  4. Click “Install Now”
  5. Click “Activate”

👉 This is the easiest method if the plugin is available in the WordPress repository.

📌 2. Upload via WordPress Dashboard (Recommended for ZIP file)

  1. Go to WordPress Dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Click “Upload Plugin”
  4. Choose the tryowbot.zip file
  5. Click “Install Now”
  6. After installation, click “Activate Plugin”

📌 3. Manual Installation (FTP Method)

  1. Extract the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload the folder to: /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Go to WordPress Dashboard → Plugins
  4. Find “Tryowbot” in the list
  5. Click “Activate”

📌 After Activation

  1. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  2. Open Tryowbot menu in WordPress dashboard
  3. Configure API settings and create your first trigger
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Does this plugin send WhatsApp messages directly?

Tryowbot manages templates and triggers. It requires a WhatsApp API provider to send messages.

Can I use image templates?

Yes. Both static and dynamic image-based templates are supported.

Can I map WooCommerce variables?

Yes. You can map dynamic values such as:
– Customer Name
– Order ID
– Order Total
– Order Date
– Customer Email
